activity.role: Founder and superior of Pachomian monastic communities
activity.notes: Pachomius established the major cenobitic monastic community at Tabennisi around 320 and directed an expanding federation until his death in 346. He was not a ruler of Egypt.

sources.title: Philip Rousseau, Pachomius: The Making of a Community in Fourth-Century Egypt
sources.citation_text: Rousseau's study treats Pachomius, who died in 346, and the development of the monastic community he founded in fourth-century Egypt.

review_context.correction_note: Register major religious-community activity in Roman Egypt, not political sovereignty.
